Planning in Lytham

Two Conservation Areas and Article 4 Directions

Fylde Council lists Lytham (Town Centre) and Lytham (Avenues) among the ten conservation areas in the borough. St Annes has three more and Kirkham has one.

The council also lists Article 4 Directions for Lytham Conservation Area, Lytham Quays and Lytham Avenues. It explains that these remove permitted development rights, so work that wouldn't normally need planning permission can need it here. If your home is in one of those areas and you want to change the look of the roof, check with the council first.

In a conservation area the council says it looks at the whole environment, walls, railings, open spaces and trees as well as the buildings, and that buildings can matter collectively even where each one isn't important in itself.

Source: Fylde Council: conservation areas
